effect_description_eng:
[Hand] [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may play 1 play cost 4 or lower red Tamer card from your hand without paying the cost.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When one of your Tamers is played, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with ＜Blocker＞
